# v2 against the v1.2.1 computed-style baselines

Phase 8 criterion 2, second gate: the v2 SPA captured by `tools/baseline/capture-v2.mjs` at the four
routes and the five matrix sizes, diffed against `baselines/v1.2.1/computed/`. How the two captures
are held to one measurement, what is normalised before anything counts as a difference, and why the
geometry properties are reported rather than gated: `tools/baseline/diff-computed.mjs`.

## Geometry, per page

| `companies` | 60 |

The DOM differs by construction - v1.2.1 carried every modal in its markup and v2 mounts one when it
opens - and the content column is 40rem where the v1.2.1 column was 448px (owner, 2026-09-14), so
above 448px these baselines have nothing left to match. A geometry difference here is evidence of
neither parity nor its absence, which is why it is counted rather than gated.
